module: Node "Waypoints Distance" (repeat_instant). Computes the remaining distance along a list of waypoints for a vehicle and indicates whether it is driving in the right direction. Inputs: alwaysUpdate (hidden flow), vehId, waypoints (table of vec3). Outputs: distLeft, rightWay (bool), goingRightWay and goingWrongWay (flow). Without alwaysUpdate, the distance is updated only if the vehicle is moving faster than 0.5 m/s.
notes: Bug: the code writes self.pinOut.goingRigthWay (typo) while the pin is named goingRightWay: this access is nil and raises an error as soon as the calculation is reached.
Speed threshold 0.5 m/s; below this threshold the direction is considered correct.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

work.desc: Finds the segment closest to the vehicle (map.objects), sums the distance to the end, compares the speed with the segment direction for the driving direction and writes the pins.
